blogs.title: Top Places to visit in Barauli, Bihar
blogs.title_hi: बरौली में देखने के लिए शीर्ष स्थान, बिहार
blogs.content:
Barauli is a town and a notified area in the Gopalganj district in the state of Bihar, India.

 

Geography

Barauli is located at 26.4°N 84.58°E. It has an average elevation of 65 meters (213 feet).

 

Demographics

As of the 2001 India census, Barauli had a population of 34,643. Males constitute 49% of the population and females 51%. Barauli has an average literacy rate of 41%, lower than the national average of 59.5%; with 64% of the males and 36% of females literate. About 20% of the population is under 6 years of age.
